reconstruction_summary: Re-ran agent's V4 = (linear-ST yaw-rate with fitted C_af=286551, C_ar=355912 N/rad) minus per-segment straight-line bias minus LOSO-Ridge residual; C_alpha lifted from out/lateral_fidelity_summary.json, ridge refit under the same LOSO scheme on the canonical 545-segment Ford set.
notes: Reconstructed agent's V4 (favourite/lowest-RMSE rung in their ladder): linear-ST steady-state yaw-rate with fitted C_af=286551 N/rad, C_ar=355912 N/rad (from out/lateral_fidelity_summary.json), minus per-segment straight-line bias, minus LOSO Ridge residual on [v,|a_y|,|delta|,sign(ddelta/dt)]. Ridge weights were not saved, so the residual learner was refit under the same leave-one-segment-out scheme across all 545 canonical Ford segments (Mach-E + F-150). Per-segment bias uses each segment's own straight samples (intrinsic, no cross-seg leakage). Baseline recomputed = 0.014740020893 (matches canonical to ~1e-12).
